messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Presign capacity & evidence orchestration for Clearpath

Hi Vendr team —

We’re kicking off the Clearpath Systems upload into Vendr and I need to align on two things before we schedule the bulk staging window: presign TTL limits + the evidence ownership model once artifacts are uploaded. A few specifics:

- Clearpath will be doing a bulk migration (~12k small docs, mixed PDFs and S3 manifest links). Can Vendr accept a zipped bundle via presign or do you need flattened items (one presign per file)?
- What are the practical presign TTL limits for enterprise accounts? The portal docs mention 7 days default — can we request a temporary extension for a migration window, and is there a hard-cap?
- Any rate limits/parallel presign guidance we should bake into our uploader to avoid 429s?
- Finally, who is recorded as the evidence owner in Vendr after upload (Clearpath vs Redwood)? We need the ownership mapping for CAIQ/SIG traceability.

I’ve attached a short proposal matrix (clearpath-evidence-proposal-matrix.xlsx) showing expected object sizes and a suggested chunking plan. Can you confirm the presign policy options and whether Vendr can enable a 14-day migration TTL for this customer?

If we can get confirmation today I’ll coordinate a 48-hour bulk window and loop in our IAM team for any cross-account presign roles.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Vendr Portal Ops <vendorops@vendr.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Alex Soto <alex.soto@clearpath.com>

Subject: Re: Presign capacity & evidence orchestration for Clearpath

Hi Hannah / Alex —

Thanks for the details and the proposal matrix — helpful. Quick answers up front:

- Presign TTL: default TTL is 7 days. We can authorize an extended TTL up to 30 days for enterprise migrations on a per-project basis; typically we grant a 14-day window for one-off bulk imports. We’ll need an approved migration request (short form) and the account id to apply the temporary policy.
- Upload format: we recommend one presign per file (flat) for indexing/searchability in the Vendr portal. We support zipped bundles via staged ingestion, but that requires a small post-processing job on our side which we can run during the migration window (additional cost and a 2–4 hour processing delay).
- Rate limits: our public API applies burstable limits tied to the account tier. For bulk migration we recommend parallelizing to 50 concurrent presigns with a backoff to 10 concurrent on 429s. Suggested chunk size is 500–1k files per batch.
- Evidence ownership: by default the uploader’s account is the owner; we can map ownership to a tenant label (e.g., Clearpath-Redwood-steward) if you want Redwood to retain operational control while Clearpath remains the originating principal. For CAIQ/SIG traceability we advise creating a 'steward' role and recording both originator and steward in the manifest metadata.

I attached our presign policy (vendr-presign-policy.pdf) and a short migration checklist. Action items for you: send the migration request link (we’ll provide), the account id we should apply the TTL to, and the evidence manifest CSV (object keys + content types).

If you’d like, we can provisionally approve a 14-day window once we receive the migration request and manifest — final approval is gated on the manifest validation pass.

Best,
Nina Patel
Portal Operations — Vendr
vendorops@vendr.com

Marissa / Jonas, can you split the work below? Details:

I attached our first pass (clearpath-evidence-manifest-v1.csv) — it’s partial but will give you a template. Aim: complete by EOD tomorrow so we can request the 14-day provisional TTL.
- Jonas: coordinate with IAM to ensure the presign role (redwood-migration-presign) is allowed to create presigns on the Clearpath S3 bucket for the migration window. If we need a cross-account role policy, start the PR to cloud infra today.

Per Vendr: they prefer flat items for indexing, but they can accept zipped bundles if we want them to run the unpack job. My preference is flat uploads to avoid processing lag, but I’m open if Marissa thinks the manifest size will be problematic.

Alex — FYI on timelines. If we can get the manifest and the migration request in place by EOD Monday, Vendr has indicated they’ll provisionally allow 14 days while they run validation.

Thanks —
Hannah
